note: M01 now verifies Clerk JWTs on socket connection and every token renewal; room joins and events verify database membership. Some privileges (host ownership, control leases) remain M17. M02 /v1 read-only pilot remains in legacy Next, not yet hosted. M02 realtime membership is now requested from server-only Next API (not a Prisma client running in Socket.IO). M02 versioned member-sharing and read-only legacy sync endpoints now exist; write replay/real revisions remain M13.

apis.access: Public but retired: returns HTTP 410 and no server-side remote fetch (SSRF prevention); browser tabs are native Electron guests
Public liveness endpoint; no user data, secrets, DB queries or logged identity; explicitly not readiness evidence
Server-only constant-time authenticated service token; private lookup of current DB workspace membership and role for verified realtime identity
Authenticated current room member; target per-media role and grant validation (T09)
GET verified workspace member; PATCH owner-only role change; DELETE self-leave or owner/admin removal, owner cannot be revoked
GET owner/member; PATCH OWNER/ADMIN room customization; DELETE OWNER; POST authenticated join by legacy room code (invite hardening pending)
Verified member GET/POST; PATCH/DELETE ownership checks with OWNER/ADMIN override and explicit legacy-unowned fallback
Authenticated identity; GET personal rooms; POST create; DELETE owner
Authenticated user; membership not needed; no enumeration beyond availability
Authenticated Clerk session; safe identity and feature capabilities only
Versioned authenticated workspace member listing, no email or private identity data
Authenticated room owner/member read; non-member receives 404
Authenticated legacy read-only geometry snapshot; no durable revision or write replay
Authenticated room owner/member; private tab titles and URLs hidden from non-owner
Authenticated workspace list restricted to room owner/member
